subject: VM evidence: scan rhythm, SLA commitments, and remediation notes
messages:
From: Glenn Harper <glenn.harper@acme.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: VM evidence for SOC 2 / SIG review

Hi Rafael,

We're preparing the security assessment for Acme's procurement committee and need a compact evidence packet from Redwood covering vulnerability management for the last 90 days. Specifically: 1) scan cadence and tooling, 2) SLA targets for CVE remediation by severity, 3) recent exceptions or deferred patches and their compensating controls, and 4) an extract of the last authenticated scan results.

Can you provide a single packet or point me at a shared folder where we can download the files? Our deadline for the SIG review is EOD Feb 22.

Thanks,
Glenn
Glenn Harper
Security Engineer, Acme Corp
security@acme-corp.com

--
This is an external email.
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Glenn Harper <glenn.harper@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: VM evidence for SOC 2 / SIG review

Glenn — thanks for the clear list. We can assemble a minimal packet that maps to SIG/CAIQ evidence categories and the SOC 2 control families. High-level answers up front so your reviewers have something while we assemble the files: 

- Scan cadence: authenticated weekly host scans on infra nodes + weekly container image scanning in CI. Host agent reports aggregated daily; consolidated export produced weekly.
- Tooling: Tenable.sc for authenticated host scans, Trivy for image scanning (CI), and internal orchestration for scheduling and exception tracking.
- SLA targets: critical (CVSS >=9.0) targeted 72 hours, high (7.0–8.9) targeted 14 days, medium (4.0–6.9) targeted 45 days; low monitored and scheduled per release window. These are our remediation targets for customer-facing infrastructure (we can provide exceptions table).
- Exceptions: we maintain a 3rd-party CVE exception log with compensating controls; will include the current open exceptions with risk rationale and mitigation.

I'll drop the export to a shared folder and attach a brief summary PDF for now. Marissa — can you attach the 20270210 scan summary and the remediation log for CVE-2027-0156? Mina, FYI in case we need an elevated attestation doc for procurement.

Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Head of Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.com

Attachments: vm-sla-summary-2027Q1.docx (summary of targets), initial-evidence-index.txt
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Glenn Harper <glenn.harper@acme.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Feb 2027 14:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: VM evidence for SOC 2 / SIG review

On Wed, Feb 17, 2027 at 02:05 PM Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com> wrote:
> Rafael — thanks for the clear list. We can assemble a minimal packet that maps to SIG/CAIQ evidence categories and the SOC 2 control families.

Glenn — attaching the exports you requested. Brief notes:

1) scan-run-20270210-summary.csv — exported from Tenable.sc; contains host-level findings from the authenticated scan run on 2027-02-10. Columns include: host, plugin_id, cvss, first_found, last_found, mitigation_status. We redacted internal hostnames to host-xxxx for the shared packet.

2) CVE-2027-0156-remediation-log.pdf — remediation timeline for that high-severity finding that was discovered in the 2027-01 baseline. It includes owner, patch windows, validation steps and final verification run id. Root cause: upstream package that received an emergency backport. Closure verified in the 2027-02-10 scan.

3) vm-sla-summary-2027Q1.docx — our internal SLA table and where each class of asset maps (customer-facing infra vs. internal dev VMs).

Notes on exceptions: the exceptions sheet is in the shared Drive and is access-controlled; I've included a view link (read-only). We avoid placing PII in these exports.

If you need a short attestation letter on company letterhead stating the remediation commitments, Mina — can you generate a 1-paragraph attestation we can attach? If we need signatures, we'll route it through Legal.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Security Program Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: scan-run-20270210-summary.csv; CVE-2027-0156-remediation-log.pdf; vm-sla-summary-2027Q1.docx
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Glenn Harper <glenn.harper@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 15:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: VM evidence for SOC 2 / SIG review

Glenn — thanks for the patience. I've created a scoped evidence folder and uploaded the files Marissa referenced. Summary of what you can expect in the package: 

- Summary PDF (vm-sla-summary-2027Q1.docx) — SLA table, remediation timelines by severity, and mapping to SOC 2 CC6/CC7 control objectives.
- Technical exports (scan-run-20270210-summary.csv) — redacted host identifiers and exported raw findings.
- Remediation proof (CVE-2027-0156-remediation-log.pdf) — timeline and validation screenshots; closure validated on 2027-02-10.
- Exceptions manifest (read-only Drive link) — rationale and compensating controls for deferred items.

Attestation: as an initial procurement artifact we can provide an unsigned attestation statement below. If Acme requires an executed letter on letterhead we will coordinate Legal and schedule signatures.

Attestation (unsigned):
Redwood Inference attests that, to the best of our knowledge as of 2027-02-18, the attached vulnerability management exports accurately reflect our production scan results and remediation timelines. Redwood follows a weekly authenticated host scanning cadence for production infrastructure and targets remediation for critical and high findings within the timeframes documented in the SLA file. Exceptions are tracked centrally and include compensating controls as documented.

If you need a granular CSV filtered for specific CVE IDs or a crosswalk to SIG question IDs, tell us which fields you want and we will provide an extract.

Next steps: Glenn — let us know if the shared folder meets your reviewers' needs or if you want the attestation on letterhead (we will need ~2 business days to get sign-off).

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Head of Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.com

Attachments: link to Drive folder (https://drive.redwood.com/shared/ACM-4521/vm-evidence-2027Q1)
